; Same CFG as block-a.ll in the spelling clang actually emits above -O0: the
; entry block has no header at all and every other label is a number drawn from
; the same counter as the values. Recovering the entry's implicit name is part
; of what this pair checks -- get it wrong and the successor edges dangle.
define i32 @f(i1 %0) {
  br i1 %0, label %2, label %3

2:
  br label %4

3:
  br label %4

4:
  %5 = phi i32 [ 11, %2 ], [ 22, %3 ]
  ret i32 %5
}
